reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 32 questions: solved complete German sentences, assessed all four options per question, checked accepted answer linkage, inflections, noun senses, natural usage, hints, bilingual explanations and distinct scenarios. 16 sources authored and 4 deferred for level, source error, register or sense ambiguity. Corrected Ärztin gender (deferred), Aufbau abstract plural/sense, Arzneimittel unchanged plural, Aufnahme admission sense, Aufforderung request/demand and Auftraggeber commissioning role. Human editorial approval, CEFR certification and rights clearance remain pending; publicationApproved=false. Follow-up pass: repaired awkward 'die Treppe hinauf' nominalization and strengthened the assistant-role cue in two variants; rechecked all choices and answer renderings.
